answer: Clone swarms cannot fake a timed acoustic path from a data center. A joiner locks 36 coins for 12 days and records a 90-second hydrophone clip from a published cliff ledge, starting at the seed-derived minute. An island beacon 14 km across the ocean emits a reference tone. Two reviewers older than 15 epochs, with no shared counterparties in 50 days, mark the arrival delay. Weight unlocks only when both delays sit within 80 ms of the travel time recomputed from published coordinates. Reviewers who certify more than one joiner per epoch, or a reused clip, forfeit the bond and 60 days of weight.
